title: Knowledge selection
intro: Choose what Persona reads and keeps. Item overrides come first, followed by the first matching priority level.
items_hint: Removing an override returns the item to its rules. Existing overrides remain even when a source is unavailable.
not_read: Do not read or store new content from this item.
store_all: Store all content. Blank days follows the deciding rule, then the text retention setting.
chat_personal: Read only for personal rules: your messages and mentions of you.
doc_rules: Read and store according to document signal rules.
priority_hint: Levels run from top to bottom. Within a level, any matching enabled rule keeps the content; the longest retention wins. A matching disabled level stops lower levels.
message_days: Blank days uses text retention; blank attachments uses the source attachment retention, capped by text retention.
doc_days: Only explicit document days schedule pruning. Blank days does not introduce default deletion; documents without signals keep their existing behavior.
pruning: Turning a rule off stops new writes; it does not delete stored content. Retention pruning is separate. Changes apply after Save.
cached: Showing the history import plan while the import is running or stopped.
no_sources: No chat-history sources for this assistant.
missing_identity: This document has no source identity. Its override cannot be added safely.
unsupported: This selection document is unsupported or invalid. Nothing has been replaced. Reload after checking the hub version.
external_change: The hub reported a selection change. Reload and reconcile before saving this draft.
invalid_fields: Days must be whole numbers from 1 to 36500, or blank. Context must be a whole number from 0 to 200, or blank.
store_all_doc: Store all content. Blank days follows document rules and creates no default deletion deadline.
